title: Terraform Module Design Plan
description: A structured plan for a Terraform module/state design, so this skill's anti-patterns and Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/terraform_module_audit.mjs.

moduleSourcePin.description: How callers reference the module source. Branch (e.g. main) is the floating-reference anti-pattern.

dynamicResourceIterator.description: The iterator used for dynamic resource sets.

resourcesHaveIdentity.description: True if the iterated resources have stable identity (users, named buckets) rather than being N interchangeable copies.

ignoreChangesScope.description: The lifecycle ignore_changes posture: specific attribute paths, blanket all (a defect), or none.

stateBackend.description: Where state lives: remote with locking + encryption (required), plain remote, or local disk.

stateSplitByBlastRadius.description: True if state is split per (environment x stack) rather than one monolithic file.

secretsInTfvars.description: True if any secret value lives in a committed tfvars file.

variablesValidated.description: True if every constrained variable carries a description and a validation block.

planFileBoundApply.description: True if CI runs terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan and applies that exact file, binding the apply to a reviewed state version.

driftCheckScheduled.description: True if a scheduled read-only plan (-detailed-exitcode) runs at least daily and non-zero exits are investigated.

providerVersionsPinned.description: True if required_version and every provider are pinned (pessimistic ~> constraints) in versions.tf.

ciAuthMethod.description: How CI authenticates to the cloud provider.
